## Syntax

<!-- gen:begin syntax -->

One out of it starts at `"sourcePort": "extension"`; a parameter is set in `params` (leave out the ones at their default), driven by an edge to `par:brushingRadius`, or read elsewhere as `ch('brushing/brushingRadius')`.
